title: Lab results service: a transaction that needs a second pooled connection
name: Lab results pool

questions.prompt: The overnight analyzer feed stopped importing lab results at 02:14 and stayed stuck until someone restarted the service. There were no errors in the logs, the database showed every pool connection idle in an open transaction, and single results entered by hand on the day shift were fine. Compliance separately noticed audit entries for results that were never saved. Fix labs/results.ts so the tests pass.
